definitions.explanation: Thin paper coated with a dark waxy substance on one side, used to make copies when writing or typing. Placed between sheets so that pressure from writing transfers the coating to the sheet below. Still used in some multi-copy forms in Japan.

examples.japanese: カーボン{紙|し}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挟|はさ}んで→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write with carbon paper inserted between the sheets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧カーボン{紙|し}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}った→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, opportunities to use carbon paper have decreased.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧カーボン{紙|し}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{写|うつ}ります→写る：11494_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: This form has carbon paper inside, so if you write firmly, it will copy onto the sheet below.

notes:
A hybrid compound of the loanword ⟦カーボン→カーボン：10843_kaabon⟧ (carbon) and {紙|し} (paper). While carbon paper has become less common due to digital technology, it is still used in some official multi-copy forms (⟦{複写|ふくしゃ}→複写：19000_fukusha⟧{式|しき}) in Japan, such as delivery receipts and certain government documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カーボン{紙|し}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挟|はさ}む→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧: to insert carbon paper
- カーボン{紙|し}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{複写|ふくしゃ}する→複写する：21626_fukushasuru⟧: to copy using carbon paper
- カーボン{紙|し}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧: carbon paper mark/trace

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{複写|ふくしゃ}→複写：19000_fukusha⟧{紙|し}: copy paper — paper designed to produce copies, may or may not use carbon
- ノーカーボン{紙|し}: carbonless copy paper — self-copying paper that doesn't need separate carbon sheets
- トレーシングペーパー: tracing paper — translucent paper for tracing designs, different purpose
